title: BikeLab Di2/AXS Diagnostic
description:
Browser-only decision tree for troubleshooting electronic bicycle shifting: Shimano Di2 12-speed road (RD-R9250/R8150/R7150), Shimano Di2 11-speed with junction A, and SRAM eTap AXS road and XPLR. 7 questions, 30 answers, 22 diagnoses in English, Spanish and Portuguese.

Version 3.0.0 is the audited version. Every diagnosis cites the Shimano or SRAM document it comes from, with the page; the record of claims, sources and the errors found in the previous version is in docs/verification.md. Di2 12-speed and 11-speed are separate branches because their buttons and procedures differ. Steps without a manufacturer source were removed.

Not affiliated with Shimano or SRAM. Di2 and AXS are trademarks of their owners. A diagnostic aid, not a replacement for the dealer's manual or warranty service.
